outcome: One canonical rc7 process accepted the mandatory inert task, emitted sentinel activation and stock-headless readiness in order, then was terminated and completely cleaned without reaching a worker or provider.

reruns.cause: The first source-evidence prose repeated two exact Git object IDs even though the receipt requires machine-only ref readings.
reruns.control: The preflight rejected the draft; the preserved corrected receipt contains zero caller-supplied object IDs.

reruns.cause: A semicolon-separated command allowed the initial commit to proceed after git diff --cached --check reported two blank EOF lines.
reruns.control: The lines and bound hash were corrected before preexecution, and all later compound gates use explicit fail-fast exit checks.

reruns.cause: One widened packet included the already-known immutable pre-source-repair digest selector.
reruns.control: The final applicability set retains all current tests and explicitly deselects the one frozen historical selector.

reruns.cause: A test assumed two report phrases were contiguous across a deliberate Markdown line break.
reruns.control: The verifier now checks the two semantic clauses independently.

reruns.cause: The first closeout intent used descriptive incident stages and candidate states outside the clockwork's exact closed vocabulary.
reruns.control: The read-only check rejected with zero publication; the corrected intent uses only admitted deterministic_verification and candidate-state values.

assessment: The Harness is now proven viable through stock pre-worker readiness under the bounded rc7 composition. The clockwork materially helped by rejecting freehand Git bindings before execution, and none of the remaining procedure corrections consumed another native process. The next honest gate is a provider-free attempt-005 readiness decision before any occupied DeepSeek worker is authorised.
